questions.q:
Which of the following expressions equals the height, in feet, of the tree shown?

<svg viewBox="0 0 200 150" width="200" height="150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <polygon points="20,130 150,130 150,30" stroke="black" fill="none" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="70" y="145" font-size="14">18 feet</text>
  <text x="155" y="80" font-size="14">?</text>
  <text x="40" y="125" font-size="12">40°</text>
  <path d="M40,130 A20,20 0 0,0 35,117" stroke="black" fill="none"/>
</svg>
questions.explain: The diagram shows a right triangle where the angle is $40^\circ$, the adjacent side to the angle has a length of 18 feet, and we want to find the length of the opposite side (the height, let's call it $h$). By the definition of tangent, $\tan(40^\circ) = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}} = \frac{h}{18}$. Multiplying both sides by 18 gives $h = 18 \tan(40^\circ)$.
